title: HRM models of online labor platforms: Strategies of market and corporate logics
venue: Frontiers in Sociology 7, 980301 (2022 volume; published 6 January 2023)
method: Comparative platform analysis distinguishes intermediary models and degrees of managerial control.
finding: Platform governance differs across business models; a marketplace must state who selects and directs work.
limitation: The study is not a Kazakhstan home-repair evaluation.
use: Customer selection and provider-defined offers; explicit moderator role. FR-05, FR-07, FR-15.

title: Red flags, sob stories, and scams: The contested meaning of governance on carework labor platforms
method: Ethnography, platform observations and interviews with 42 careworkers.
finding: Trust signals coexist with scams and conflicting expectations of platform responsibility.
limitation: Carework in US cities differs from residential repair in Kazakhstan.
use: Report/appeal workflow, clear verification labels and restricted contact access. FR-14, FR-15.

title: Datasheets for Datasets
method: A structured documentation framework for dataset provenance and use.
finding: Dataset composition, collection, intended use and limitations should be documented.
limitation: Documentation alone cannot make a dataset representative or remove label errors.
use: Dataset card, consent/source fields and per-language coverage. NFR-10.

title: Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science
method: Review of leakage problems and a reproducibility case study.
finding: Leakage can make model comparisons overly optimistic.
limitation: Scientific prediction settings differ from production request classification.
use: Group near-duplicates before splitting; fit preprocessing on train only; freeze test data. NFR-10.

title: Recent Advancements and Challenges of Turkic Central Asian Language Processing
method: Survey of language resources and NLP methods for Central Asian Turkic languages.
finding: Data scarcity and language-specific characteristics limit direct transfer of general NLP results.
limitation: The survey supplies no repair-request benchmark.
use: Evaluate Kazakh separately; document mixed-language and transliteration cases. FR-12, NFR-10.

authors: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loic Magne and Nils Reimers
title: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
method: Benchmark spanning multiple embedding tasks and datasets.
finding: No evaluated embedding method dominates every task.
limitation: General benchmarks do not establish UyCare domain quality.
use: Choose the model using local classification and latency evaluation. NFR-09.

title: Unsupervised Cross-lingual Representation Learning at Scale
method: Large-scale multilingual masked-language pretraining and transfer evaluation.
finding: Multilingual representations support cross-language transfer.
limitation: Pretraining scale does not guarantee reliable small-domain or mixed-language classification.
use: Transformer alternative, evaluated against a simpler baseline. ADR-004.

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
method: Siamese/triplet training produces reusable sentence embeddings.
finding: Sentence embeddings provide a practical representation for downstream similarity and classification.
limitation: The original work does not validate Kazakh repair categories.
use: Foundation for embedding-based alternatives; not evidence of local accuracy. ADR-004.

title: Efficient Few-Shot Learning Without Prompts
method: Contrastive sentence-transformer fine-tuning followed by a classifier.
finding: SetFit offers a prompt-free approach when labelled examples are scarce.
limitation: Results depend on datasets and encoder; no UyCare performance claim follows.
use: Candidate low-data experiment after a reliable labelled set exists. ADR-004.

title: Multilingual E5 Text Embeddings: A Technical Report
method: Multilingual contrastive embedding training with several model sizes.
finding: Model size offers a quality versus inference-cost choice.
limitation: An embedding model is not a ready-made repair-category classifier.
use: Candidate multilingual encoder with a trained classification head. ADR-004.

title: Service marketplace homepage
method: Public description of request posting and specialist offers.
finding: Customers can compare offered prices and select specialists; reviews and verification claims are advertised.
limitation: Marketing copy is not an independent audit; policies need separate verification.
use: Existing-system comparison and removal of the unsupported no-competitors claim.

title: How Taskrabbit Works
method: Public description of tasker selection, hourly rates, chat and card payments.
finding: A booking-oriented alternative provides useful workflow comparison.
limitation: The reviewed page describes its own market; Kazakhstan coverage is not established.
use: Comparison of booking, pricing, communication and payment models.

title: How it works
method: Public explanation of task posting, offers, profiles and held payments.
finding: A request-and-offer model is already established in another market.
limitation: Australian features and terms cannot be assumed to apply in Kazakhstan.
use: Comparison and careful distinction between direct payment and platform-held funds.

title: Django REST framework
method: API framework documentation.
finding: Authentication, serialization and API tooling support a shared backend.
limitation: Framework features do not implement UyCare permissions automatically.
use: ADR-001 and API design.

title: About PostgreSQL
method: Database capabilities overview.
finding: Transactions, constraints and relational modelling suit linked marketplace records.
limitation: Concurrency correctness still requires application design and tests.
use: ADR-002 and one-assignment invariant.

title: Django Channels
method: ASGI/WebSocket integration documentation.
finding: Django can support persistent chat connections.
limitation: A connection layer does not provide durable message history or access control by itself.
use: ADR-003 and persisted messages before notification.

title: FastAPI
method: Python API framework documentation.
finding: Typed API development is a reasonable alternative.
limitation: Admin and marketplace modules still require integration choices.
use: Backend technology comparison.

title: NestJS documentation
method: Modular Node.js server framework documentation.
finding: TypeScript backend is a reasonable alternative to Python.
limitation: Python ML adds an integration boundary if served separately.
use: Backend technology comparison.

title: Introduction to InnoDB
method: Transactional relational storage documentation.
finding: MySQL is also a viable transactional database.
limitation: UyCare has no measured database benchmark establishing a winner.
use: Database technology comparison.

title: Transactions
method: Single-document atomicity and multidocument transaction documentation.
finding: MongoDB supports transactions; rejecting it for having none would be incorrect.
limitation: Linked entities would require a deliberate document/transaction design.
use: Database technology comparison.

title: Learn GraphQL
method: Typed client-directed queries and schema documentation.
finding: Flexible queries are an API alternative.
limitation: Schema, resolver authorization and query-cost policies add work.
use: Communication technology comparison.

title: Introduction to gRPC
method: RPC and protocol buffer documentation.
finding: Typed generated clients are a communication alternative.
limitation: Browser integration and debugging must be considered.
use: Communication technology comparison.

title: Import from CSV
method: CSV import using Google Sheets as intermediary.
finding: Tasks can be transferred after configuring an instance and field mapping.
limitation: A prepared CSV does not mean live issues or assignees exist.
use: YouTrack setup and import instructions.
